title: action panel
rule: Instead of burying a large set of related commands in menus, present them on a richly organized panel that stays visible.

citation.source: Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Doing Things — Action Panel (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: A large related command set is on a visible, organized panel.
fail_when: That set exists only buried in menus, with no staying-visible panel.
